Game Overview

In Elemental Gloves Magic Power, the core idea is straightforward: command the elements in an electrifying arcade adventure. Wield powerful magic gloves to unleash flames, lightning, and electromagnetic waves against foes. Master smooth controls and strategic combos to outwit enemies across evolving challenges, transforming into the ultimate elemental master in this visually stunning quest.
